annotations.title: World Bank indicator history and trend

description: World Bank indicator history and trend — Full time series of any World Bank World Development Indicator for 1-8 countries, with analysis: first and latest value, absolute and % change, CAGR, mean, standard deviation, max/min years, linear trend (rising/falling/flat) with slope and R-squared, the last 10 year-over-year changes and a ranking by latest value. indicator= takes a code (e.g. NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, find codes with /v1/econ/indicators) or an alias: gdp, gdp_per_capita, gdp_growth, population, inflation, unemployment, life_expectancy, debt, exports, imports, fdi, current_account, reserves, internet, urban, poverty, gini, fertility, lending_rate, real_interest_rate. country= ISO2/ISO3 codes, comma separated. Optional start= and end= years (default last 25 years). Source: World Bank (CC BY 4.0). JSON. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: econ_indicator_history
